note: Tuvalu, read in the Immigration Regulations in the 2022 Revised Edition on the Attorney General's legislation site (2026-11-03): employment in Tuvalu is a purpose of the permit to enter and reside, applied for with the employer's sponsorship form. A visitor's permit allows no employment, but the Principal Immigration Officer may endorse one specially, for up to 30 days and 100 dollars more, for a visitor who intends to engage in business or employment; that endorsement is itself a permission asked for and paid, not days worked without one, so no days are kept.

sources.title: Tuvalu Legislation, Immigration Regulations, Cap. 24.15.1, 2022 Revised Edition (made under section 18 of the Immigration Act, commenced 30 May 2014), regulations 2 to 7
sources.said: 2 (2) ... the conditions of a visitor permit shall be: (a) no employment or conduct of business activities permitted ... (3) The Principal Immigration Officer may issue to any visitor who intends to engage in business or employment in Tuvalu a visitors permit with a special endorsement to engage in business ... for a maximum stay of 30 days, upon payment of a fee of $100 in addition to any fee imposed under subsection (1). ... 3 (1) The Principal Immigration Officer may issue a permit to enter and reside ... for any the following purposes: (a) the conduct of business in Tuvalu; (b) employment in Tuvalu; (c) study in Tuvalu; ... (f) a family re-union or family support purpose ... (2) A permit to enter and reside may be granted for a maximum stay of one year and may be extended in accordance with subsection 4(4). ... 4 (5) A permit to enter and reside shall not be extended more than three times in any five year period, unless the Minister ... certifies that to do so is in the national interest. 5 (2) An application for a Permit to Enter and Reside to undertake employment must be accompanied by: (a) an employer sponsorship form in accordance with Form 5 of Schedule 2 ... 6 (2) ... (g) where the person has a Permit to Enter and Reside to undertake employment, such employment has ceased or the person has changed employment ... 7 Fees for a permit to enter and reside and for the extension of a permit to enter and reside shall be as follows: (a) to conduct of business in Tuvalu: (i) $600 for the principal applicant ... if lodged outside Tuvalu, and (ii) $1,200 for the principal applicant ... if lodged inside Tuvalu; (b) for employment in Tuvalu: (i) $600 ... outside Tuvalu, and (ii) $1,200 ... in Tuvalu; (c) to study in Tuvalu - $300 for the principal applicant ... (f) a family re-union or family support purpose - $100 for the principal applicant
